To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a multi stream QA approach that uses a combination of question and answer type compatibility, as well as redundancy and overlap features, can outperform the individual performance of the best system in a given set of questions.
a multi stream question answering system that selects the correct answer from several QA systems can outperform any of them.

(i) it is feasible to combine the answers from different QA systems, and (ii) a supervised approach that takes into account the redundancy between answers and the compatibility between the question and answer types is able to select the best answer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the selection of the most adequate QA systems for a given question and the combination of the results.
the problem of selecting the correct answer from several QA systems.
the problem of combining several QA systems in order to improve the individual QA results.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed multi stream approach is a good candidate for the selection of the most relevant answers to a given question.
, in our case, a multi stream QA approach is able to improve the estimated QA performance, but not in a significant way.
the proposed multi stream approach is a good alternative for the QA task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed multi stream approach is a very promising technique to improve the results in the question answering task.
we have shown that it is possible to learn the selection of the right answer among a set of QA system responses.

, in the context of QA, the multi stream approach is a promising way to integrate the results from different systems, and that, by using a supervised approach, the integration process could be improved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the selection of the most appropriate answers from a given set is a relevant problem for the improvement of the QA performance.
a multi stream QA approach can be useful for QA, and that the selection of the most relevant answer from different QA approaches can improve the performance of a QA system.
, in the context of multi stream QA, it is not enough to combine answers from different systems.
